messages:
lisa-cs: FYI customer ACME (acct acme-123) reports 403 when calling /v1/generate and /v1/rerank. Embeddings calls succeed. Using tenant service key svc_tenant_ABC. Request id: req_01FZ9X2. They see insufficient_scope for 'generate'.

sam-eng: Can you paste the Authorization header (token redacted) and the exact response body + X-Request-Id? Also which environment (prod/us-east)?

lisa-cs: prod/us-east. Response:
```json
{"error":"insufficient_scope","message":"missing scope: generate","required":["generate"]}
```

lisa-cs: I grabbed the token introspection output from the customer (sanitized):
```json
{
  "sub":"svc_tenant_ABC",
  "scopes":"\"[\"embeddings\",\"rerank\"]\"",
  "exp":1700000000
}
```

sam-eng: interesting — the 'scopes' claim is a JSON-stringified array (double-encoded). Our authorizer expects either a space-separated string or an array; it currently iterates tokens and sees a single string value '["embeddings","rerank"]' which doesn't match 'generate'. That's why generate missing.

devon-ml: I can repro. The sso-provisioner got a recent change where we persist scopes via JSON.stringify for some tenants; for service keys we then add another layer of quotes during rotation. Repro steps I used:
1) create svc key through provisioning api with scopes=["embeddings","rerank","generate"]
2) rotate key via POST /provisioner/rotate -> resulting JWT claim 'scopes' ends up as stringified JSON inside string
3) call /v1/generate -> 403

sam-eng: Short-term mitigation: update auth middleware to try JSON.parse when scopes is a string and startsWith '['. I'll push a patch to staging now.

maria-ops: I scheduled a rollback of the provisioning change in staging and will run a sweep for recently-rotated tenant keys. Also opening an internal ticket INF-7892.

support-bot: created support ticket #7892 for acme-123, linked incident INF-7892. Customer notified: "we're investigating a token encoding issue" :white_check_mark:

sam-eng: Patch rolled to staging, added parser fallback (tries space-split, then JSON.parse on string). Verified generate works with double-encoded token in staging.

devon-ml: Planning a migration: script to normalize existing svc keys for tenants rotated in last 7 days. Will coordinate with ops for a safe rollout.

lisa-cs: Notified customer with repro and ETA for fix. Keeping this thread open until prod sweep finishes.

maria-ops: Prod sweep scheduled in 1h, will post update. :clock1:

lisa-cs: thanks everyone.
